prompt: Our team at NordicGreen Energy is scoping a new biomass district heating facility in Trondheim. We're planning to process locally sourced sawdust (arriving at about 45% moisture) into a 8 MW thermal output plant running 7800 hours per year with a grate-type boiler at 82% efficiency. We want to pursue ENplus-A1 pellet certification for the output product, and we need 14 days of on-site fuel storage. Please produce a structured feasibility report called `feasibility_report.json` that summarizes all the key technical parameters for this project — including the effective heating value of our wet feedstock, the fuel consumption rate, the annual fuel tonnage, the required storage volume, and the ENplus-A1 quality certification thresholds. All figures must come from our internal biomass reference tooling available in this workspace.
